CWE-78.name: OS Command Injection
CWE-78.description: The software constructs an OS command using externally-influenced input, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary system commands.

CWE-79.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
CWE-79.description: The software does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page.

CWE-80.name: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS)
CWE-80.description: The software receives input from an upstream component, but does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes script-related HTML tags before inserting it into dynamic web content.

CWE-89.name: SQL Injection
CWE-89.description: The software constructs a SQL query using untrusted user input without proper validation or parameterization, allowing database compromise.

CWE-20.name: Improper Input Validation
CWE-20.description: The software receives input or data, but does not validate or incorrectly validates that the input has the properties that are required to process the data safely.

CWE-22.name: Path Traversal
CWE-22.description: The software uses external input to construct a pathname intended to identify a file or directory located underneath a restricted directory.

CWE-119.name: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
CWE-119.description: The software performs operations on a memory buffer, but can read from or write to a memory location that is outside the intended buffer boundary.

CWE-125.name: Out-of-bounds Read
CWE-125.description: The software reads data past the end, or before the beginning, of the intended buffer, leading to information disclosure or crashes.

CWE-190.name: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
CWE-190.description: The software performs a calculation that can produce an integer overflow or wraparound, resulting in logic flaws or buffer overflows.

CWE-200.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
CWE-200.description: The software exposes sensitive information to an actor that is not explicitly authorized to have access to that information.

CWE-287.name: Improper Authentication
CWE-287.description: The software accepts claims about identity from an actor without adequately verifying that the claims are true.

CWE-306.name: Missing Authentication for Critical Function
CWE-306.description: The software does not perform any authentication for functionality that requires a provable user identity or consumes significant resources.

CWE-352.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
CWE-352.description: The web application does not, or cannot, sufficiently verify whether a well-formed, valid, consistent request was intentionally provided by the user.

CWE-416.name: Use After Free
CWE-416.description: The software references memory after it has been freed, which can lead to program execution flow manipulation or remote code execution.

CWE-434.name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
CWE-434.description: The software allows the attacker to upload or transfer files of dangerous types that can be directly processed or executed by the environment.

CWE-502.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
CWE-502.description: The software deserializes untrusted data without sufficiently verifying that the resulting data will be valid, leading to remote code execution.

CWE-787.name: Out-of-bounds Write
CWE-787.description: The software writes data past the end, or before the beginning, of the intended buffer, causing data corruption or code execution.

CWE-862.name: Missing Authorization
CWE-862.description: The software does not perform an authorization check when an actor attempts to access a resource or perform an action.

CWE-918.name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
CWE-918.description: The web server receives a URL or similar request from an upstream component and retrieves the contents without adequate validation.
